items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: Who did he play with? Rudy, we'd off. Rudy, we'd off. Rudy, we'd off. And, uh, Ross Garman, band.

ctx.x: Why did guys like Nicholas and Darnell Howard, when they'd play those sax choruses, when would they get their ideas?

Well, they used to listen to a, what's this guy named, played sax. He was very popular. Around the 20s, in the 20s, early 20s. Who did he play with? Rudy, we'd off. Rudy, we'd off. Rudy, we'd off. And, uh, Ross Garman, band. I mean, those guys, listen to those bands, you know. And they used to, and you try to get tone like those guys, you know. You know, and, uh, we played a lot of stocks and they would, you know, scratch out a lot of them. A lot of stuff in arrangement on the stocks, you know. They had a small…
Where were these records made? You remember? I don't know.
